title: Not a Lot of Light
text: Not a Lot of Light. This Mario light is unique and fun. It doesn't really put out a lot of light. It's more of a night light or just decoration. You can rearrange the blocks to create scenes. I don't know how many times you would want to change it. My family loves video games and especially Mario. It's a fun addition to the game room.

product_metadata.title: Paladone Super Mario Bros Build a Level Light, Includes 12 Double-Sided Blocks & 16 Total Pieces, Officially Licensed Nintendo Merchandise
features: MAMA MIA! Fans of Super Mario will love this amazing Build A Level Light with its 16 separate conductive blocks that light-up and can be arranged in any combination upon the ground block base

OUT OF THE SCREEN: Take building a level out of the screen and into your home. Mains operated (mains adaptor included). Featuring familiar icons and characters, each of the 16 light-up blocks is double-sided providing endless stacking combinations

GREAT COLLECTABLE GIFT: This Super Mario Bros. Build A Level Light is supplied in a full-color gift box and makes the perfect present to give any fan. It also makes a unique addition to any collection of official Super Mario or Nintendo memorabilia

OFFICIAL MERCHANDISE: Perfect gift for all Super Mario fans, superb quality, this Super Mario Build A Level Light is officially licensed and approved by Nintendo, this light is perfect for any bedroom, gaming den, or man cave
Original giftware: For those looking for novelty items and all things geek, crazy, and unique, Paladone is your best source for top selling and quality toys, mugs, collectibles, and novelties
